buildCommand: node scripts/check-env.js && npx expo export --platform web

rewrites.comment: The app is a single page: expo-router handles paths in the browser, so every URL has to reach index.html or a refresh on /clips is a 404. Vercel serves real files first, so this catch-all never shadows the bundle or the assets.

headers.comment: Bundle filenames carry a content hash, so a given URL can never change.
